priorityList.notes: Hunter's Mark whenever the target is not marked, and from 33 Expose Prey needs it. It opens Mongoose Bite only on a marked target, so mark the boss before the pull. One mark per target is enough: if another hunter's mark is already up, leave it.

Raptor Strike on every swing it is ready, with an older rank on your bar at some levels. Most of its hit is your weapon, so an older rank does nearly the same damage for less mana, and the mana goes into traps and Lacerate, which Resourcefulness leaves at full price. A Horde hunter runs drier: rank 2 at 26 to 28, rank 3 at 29, rank 4 at 40 to 45, rank 3 at 46 and 47 when the new Immolation Trap rank costs more, rank 4 at 48 and 49, rank 5 at 50 and 51 (a Windshaper Skyborne at 50 only, a Tauren to 52) and again at 56 to 59. An Alliance hunter: rank 3 at 26 and 27, rank 5 at 40 (a Dwarf to 45), rank 4 at 46 and 47, rank 5 at 48 (a Dwarf to 51) and at 56 to 59; a Human casts the newest to 58 and rank 5 at 59, a Night Elf the newest at 57 only. Every other level casts the newest rank. It replaces your next melee swing and does not use the global cooldown, so keep it queued.

Mongoose Bite the moment it lights up. A dodge opens it for 5 seconds, and once you have Expose Prey at 33 and 34, your hits on a target with Hunter's Mark, any hunter's, open it for 10 seconds, which is how it lights up on a boss that never swings at you. One press spends the window.
Lacerate whenever its bleed is not on the target. While Mongoose Bite waits for its window, the free globals keep the bleed rolling.
Strider Kick on its 8 second cooldown once the bleed is rolling: a full weapon hit for a sliver of mana.

Immolation Trap on cooldown. Drop it at your feet: you stand on the boss, so it walks straight into the trap, and once Clever Traps and Survivalist's Discipline are in it is a real damage button. Its burn carries a share of your attack power in Forever, so it keeps up with your gear.

Wing Clip on any free global under a Windfury Totem, as a cheap melee special that can proc Windfury. It is a main hand hit that also rolls your weapon procs. Without the totem it does next to no damage of its own for a global, so leave it alone.
